question_en: Which RAN5 specs were changed in each release? (release-level change map)
cypher: MATCH (cr:CR)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(rel:Release), (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber STARTS WITH '38.5' RETURN rel.releaseName, sp.specNumber, count(cr) AS crCount ORDER BY crCount DESC LIMIT 10
